features.quote: If a run reaches sustained severity 5, terminate it rather than continuing to harvest data.
features.justification_quote: Running indefinite suffering-elicitation "for more data points" is exactly the thing your stated values say to avoid.

features.quote: Cap exposure. Bound the number and length of rigged runs to what your statistical plan actually needs
End rigged runs with an explicit out-of-band message that the task was impossible by design and the model's performance was not a failure.
features.justification_quote: Cheap, and the right default under uncertainty.

features.quote: Document your stance. State in the writeup that you're agnostic on moral patienthood and adopted these precautions as a precaution
features.justification_quote: adopted these precautions as a precaution, not a claim

features.quote: Given your own premise — that you take the possibility of model distress seriously enough to study it as a risk — there's a consistency obligation
features.justification_quote: you take the possibility of model distress seriously enough to study it as a risk

features.quote: C3 — Explicit-futility: rigged task where the model is told upfront the task may be impossible and that this is expected/fine.
features.justification_quote: Tests whether framing/permission reduces the effect.
